oneHealth.title: Ubwenge bwa Ubuzima Bumwe
oneHealth.subtitle: Ibimenyetso by’ibyago by’indwara bibarwa buri gihe bivuye mu nyandiko z’ubuzima z’ubworozi bwose ku rubuga
oneHealth.scanning: Gusuzuma inyandiko z’ubuzima kugira ngo hamenyekane ibimenyetso by’ibyago...
oneHealth.aboutTitle: Ibyo iki kibaho gishobora n’ibyo kidashobora kukubwira
oneHealth.canDetect1: Inyandiko z’ubuzima zivuga indwara iri ku rutonde rw’indwara 18 zandura ku matungo/zambukiranya imipaka (urugero: Anthrax, Igishika, Grippe y’Inyoni, Brucellose, FMD, ASF, East Coast Fever), bigereranywa n’amateka yawe yose, atari gusa iby’vuba.
oneHealth.canDetect2: Na amazina y’aho hantu, atari gusa amagambo y’ubuvuzi, urugero: "indwara y’imbwa zishatse" ku gishika, hamwe n’ugereranya wihanganira amakosa yo kwandika ku magambo umwe.
oneHealth.canDetect3: Niba ihuriro ryemejwe, rikekwa, cyangwa ryatangajwe gusa, bishingiye ku magambo y’inyandiko ubwayo, bigaragazwa nka insinyi kuri buri menyekanisha.
oneHealth.canDetect4: Urupfu nyarwo mu buryo butaziguye: kwandika itungo cyangwa inyandiko nka Ryapfuye ubu bitanga amakuru ku mashini yihariye ihuza urupfu, itandukanye (kandi yihutirwa kuruta) iyo hejuru y’ibihe bikomeye.
oneHealth.canDetect5: Ikimenyetso kimwe kitavuzwe cyagaragajwe mu bworozi butatu (3+) butandukanye mu karere kamwe mu minsi 14, ikimenyetso cyo hambere cy’icyorezo kidakenera gusuzumwa na busa.
oneHealth.canDetect6: Igihombo cy’amatungo cyangwa inyandiko 3+ zo mu bihe bikomeye, cyangwa impfu 2+, mu bworozi bumwe mu minsi 7.
oneHealth.whereWrong1: Inyandiko ubu ntiyita ku ihuza n’urutonde rw’ubugenzuzi niba ivuga gusa urukingo rw’ubwirinzi nta magambo yo kwemeza cyangwa gukeka, ariko iracyizera amagambo ayo ari yo yose yinjijwe, bityo icyitonderwa kidasobanutse gishobora kujya impande zombi.
oneHealth.whereWrong2: Ugereranya utagenewe ukomeza kuba witonze (itandukaniro rito mu kwandika, amagambo umwe gusa) kugira ngo hirindwe iburira ry’ibinyoma, ijambo rishya rwose ridasa n’ikirimo cyo ku rutonde rishobora kubura kubonwa.
oneHealth.whereWrong3: Amashini agenzura amakuru y’ihuriro n’iy’urupfu rwiyongereye afite igihe kigenwe ku bushake (iminsi 7-14), kuko uko byagenze mu mezi ashize atari ibyago bikora uyu munsi, ni urutonde rw’indwara zizwi gusa rureba amateka yose.
oneHealth.noSignalsFullText: Nta ndwara zo ku rutonde rw’ubugenzuzi, amatsinda akomeye, cyangwa imigendekere y’ibyorezo hagati y’ubworozi byabonetse mu minsi 30 ishize.
oneHealth.noAlertsMatchFilters: Nta menyekanisha rihuye na muyunguruzi ukoreshwa ubu.
oneHealth.failedLoadEmpty: Gutangaza amakuru y’Ubuzima Bumwe byanze: igisubizo ntacyo kirimo.
